title: Horror Freinds
description: A terrifying horror experience that turns Minecraft into a relentless nightmare. You are never safe.
body:
Welcome to the Nightmare

This modpack is built for those who want to experience true terror in Minecraft. We have removed the comfort of safety and replaced it with constant dread. Every sound you hear and every shadow you see in the distance might be your last.

Features:

Terrifying Entities: Face creatures that hunt, stalk, and mimic your every move.

Atmospheric Horror: A complete overhaul of the game's atmosphere to keep you on edge.

No Escape: Nowhere is safe—not even your base.

Warning: This experience is not for the faint of heart. Keep your volume up, and whatever you do—don't look back.
